subject.title: feat(ui): Labs settings page for experimental feature toggles

question: Should OpenClaw expose experimental feature gates through a first-class Settings → Labs page now, beginning with Code Mode, or keep feature enablement in its existing configuration workflow until the broader experimental-feature policy is approved?
rationale: The PR adds a durable Control UI product surface for experimental capabilities and its linked Swarm program is still open; code review cannot determine whether this is the intended long-term product boundary.

options.title: Sponsor Labs for Code Mode
options.body: Approve the Labs product direction, then require the stale-snapshot repair and live Gateway proof before merge.

options.title: Defer the Labs surface
options.body: Keep experimental gating in the current configuration workflow until a broader policy or the linked program is approved.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Labs for Code Mode
recommendation.body: Approve the Labs product direction, then require the stale-snapshot repair and live Gateway proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked proposal and this branch establish the clearest available ownership signal for the Labs product direction.
